description: Unit test class for DefaultMetadataHeaderKey, testing immutability, equality, parsing, path retrieval, wildcard behavior, string representation, and comparison logic.

classes.name: DefaultMetadataHeaderKeyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying behavior of DefaultMetadataHeaderKey, including immutability, equality, parsing, path logic, and comparison.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that DefaultMetadataHeaderKey and its path are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract for DefaultMetadataHeaderKey.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullPath
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to DefaultMetadataHeaderKey.of() throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithEmptyPath
methods.description: Ensures that empty JsonPointer throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: wildcardPathHasTooFewLevels
methods.description: Verifies exception is thrown for wildcard path with fewer than required levels.

methods.name: wildcardPathHasTooManyLevels
methods.description: Verifies exception is thrown for wildcard path with more than required levels.

methods.name: wildcardPathHasAsteriskLeaf
methods.description: Ensures exception if path contains '*' at leaf level.

methods.name: pathContainsAsteriskAtWrongLevel
methods.description: Checks exception when '*' appears at non-leaf positions.

methods.name: tryToParseNullString
methods.description: Verifies that parsing null string throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToParseEmptyString
methods.description: Ensures empty string parsing throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: parseValidString
methods.description: Checks that parsing a valid JsonPointer string returns the correct key.

methods.name: getSpecificPath
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the exact path of a metadata header key.

methods.name: getPathOfWildcardKey
methods.description: Checks that wildcard path returns the correct leaf as pointer.

methods.name: pathWithoutLeadingAsteriskDoesNotApplyToAllLeaves
methods.description: Verifies that non-wildcard paths do not apply to all leaves.

methods.name: pathWithLeadingAsteriskAppliesToAllLeaves
methods.description: Checks that wildcard paths with leading '*' apply to all leaves.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures the toString method produces the expected string representation.

methods.name: compareToWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies comparison logic between different instances based on path and wildcard status.
